_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid#3, and a FALSIFICATION of both its key names and its Signal. The entry says x-wall is activated via 'FLUID DYNAMIC/WALL_NORMAL_NODE_DISTANCE and related XWALL_* keys'. WALL_NORMAL_NODE_DISTANCE appears nowhere in the 4C source; the real switch is the bool X_WALL inside the section 'FLUID DYNAMIC/WALL MODEL' (src/inpar/4C_inpar_fluid.cpp), which is exactly what the upstream turbulent-channel deck f3_cha_xwall_6x8x6.4C.yaml uses (REAL_KEY_IN_UPSTREAM_DECK=1, CLAIMED_KEY_IN_UPSTREAM_DECK=0). Untouched that deck exits 0 with sixteen result tests CORRECT. Flipping X_WALL to false does NOT degrade a near-wall profile — it kills the process: SIGABRT, exit 134, terminate called after throwing Teuchos::Exceptions::InvalidParameterName, 'Error!  The parameter "xwalltoggle" does not exist', because X_WALL is read while the mesh is being read to choose the element type, so the elements still ask for a parameter that is no longer in the list. The run never reaches its result test (OFF_REACHED_RESULT_TEST=0) and no log-law text is printed by either arm (CLAIMED_LOGLAW_TEXT=0), so the claimed ~5-percent log-law comparison is not observable at all. Both invented key spellings are left unmatched by core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the switch arm: leave X_WALL on. OFF_DECK_HAS_XWALL_ON becomes 1, EXIT_OFF goes to 0 and the xwalltoggle abort disappears, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the claimed-key arm: do not inject the invented key. EXIT_CLAIMKEY goes to 0, the unmatched-input abort and CLAIMED_KEY_UNUSED=2 both disappear, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the XWALL_-prefixed arm the same way; XWALL_PREFIXED_KEY_UNUSED stops being 2 and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's|^FLUID DYNAMIC/WALL MODEL:$|FLUID DYNAMIC/WALL MODEL:\n  XWALL_TAUW_TYPE: "constant"|' "$BASE" > "$TMP/xwallkey.yaml"
